entries.zh: 停住；停下（亦指使人停住、把持不放）
entries.en: to stop, halt; (of a person) to come to a standstill; to detain
to stop or block with the hands; to hold back, intercept

entries.zh: 留住；停留不动（把人留住不放行）
entries.en: to stay, remain; to keep (someone) back, detain
to wait, await; to stop and wait for

entries.zh: 积聚；堆积、积存（把东西聚在一处）
entries.en: to accumulate, pile up; to gather (things) together
entries.notes: 西语栏残损难辨（“Detenersse con ar, iqueca ha tiempo &”），释义据汉字“积”及闽南栏附注“Juntar los”（聚拢）定夺。

entries.zh: 望楼；宫门前的观阙（守望者驻足瞭望之处）
entries.en: watchtower, gate tower where sentinels keep watch; to halt and observe
entries.notes: “守望者驻足瞭望之处”系按“阙”之古义（宫门观阙）与西语释文对应推断，未能直证。
四栏皆空缺，汉字仅存一点画痕迹，无任何可据材料。

entries.zh: 骤然止住；喝令骤停（骤，忽然）
entries.en: Stop! halt suddenly, come to an abrupt stop
entries.notes: “骤”本义“骤然”，与感叹词 Detente 的组合义（骤停）依赖推断，音写对应亦不甚吻合。

entries.zh: 牵住；拉住不放（喝令止步）
entries.en: Stop! to hold (someone) back by pulling; halt
entries.notes: 第二字（“蒂”，闽南音写 toà，疑为“带／伫”之形讹）未能确证，全条“止步、挽住”之义据西语 Detente 与首字“牵”可定。

entries.en: Stop! stand still, hold one's place
entries.notes: 第二字（蒂）存疑同上，“立定不动”之义据西语 Detente 与首字“立”可定。

entries.en: Stop! halt one's steps, come to a standstill

entries.zh: 擒手；动手擒拿（揪住其手拿下）
entries.en: Stop him! lay hands on him; to seize, grab by the hand
entries.notes: 字头“钦”疑为“擒”之形讹（闽南栏音写 liam、官话栏 kiēn 皆合“擒”），西语后段（ir lo a la manos，上手拿人）残损，按擒拿释义。

entries.en: Stop! to halt, come to a stop
to stop him, hold him back; to detain him
entries.notes: 西语释文后段（“prouiendo sele detanse”）残损难辨，“拦住”之义据 Detenerle 与首字“拦”可定。

entries.zh: 扣住他的衣裳；拉住衣裳使其不能脱身
entries.en: to detain him by his clothes; to seize his garment to hold him back
entries.notes: 第二、三字（蒂、处）与音写对应存疑，“扣住衣裳”之义据西语 Detenerle del vestido 可定。

entries.zh: 牵绊；缠绊、牵累（使灵魂为尘世所羁绊）
entries.en: to entangle, hinder; to hold back (the soul entangled by the world); to detain

entries.zh: 阙疑；存疑（对疑难之事存而不论，暂置待决）
entries.en: to leave doubtful points undecided; to suspend judgment on doubts

entries.zh: 钳住；钳制拘执（夹持捉拿）
entries.en: to grip fast (as with pincers); to seize, arrest; to detain
entries.notes: 第二字（蒂）存疑同上，“钳持捉拿”之义据西语 Detener, prender 与首字“钳”可定。
